subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should `PluginHookAgentContext.api.resetSession(reason?)` become a supported public API limited to successful, lifecycle-owned after-compaction hooks?
rationale: This is a new plugin contract with session-destruction authority and long-term compatibility implications; tests can validate mechanics but cannot establish the intended permanent SDK surface.

options.title: Approve the scoped API
options.body: Adopt the current-session-only deferred method after fixing harness ownership, restoring the memory gate, and proving the exact-head lifecycle end to end.

options.title: Keep it internal
options.body: Retain the lifecycle queue as an internal mechanism and expose a narrower owner-specific compaction capability only after a separate SDK design review.

options.title: Reject hook-driven resets
options.body: Keep session resets exclusively in existing command and gateway-owner paths, requiring context engines to signal recovery without directly requesting rotation.

recommendation.title: Approve the scoped API
recommendation.body: Adopt the current-session-only deferred method after fixing harness ownership, restoring the memory gate, and proving the exact-head lifecycle end to end.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal spans the harness registry, Codex compaction, and gateway reset service that jointly define this API boundary.
